subject.title: fix(doctor): preserve allowlist entries for version-bound runtime plugins during stale config scan

question: Should version-bound runtime plugin IDs receive a temporary allowlist-only upgrade exception, or become a permanent ID-wide exemption from doctor stale-config cleanup?
rationale: The shipped regression requires compatibility handling, but the PR currently changes cleanup semantics for every config surface and does not define when the exception ends.

options.title: Scope and time-bound preservation
options.body: Preserve version-bound IDs only on `plugins.allow` while the release backfill contract exists, with tests and a clear removal condition.

options.title: Install from allowlist intent
options.body: Teach the release backfill repair to treat recognized allowlist-only runtime IDs as install candidates, avoiding a broad stale-cleanup exemption.

options.title: Accept the broad exemption
options.body: Keep the ID-wide preservation permanently, accepting that unrelated stale `codex` references will no longer be repaired.

recommendation.title: Scope and time-bound preservation
recommendation.body: Preserve version-bound IDs only on `plugins.allow` while the release backfill contract exists, with tests and a clear removal condition.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal spans both the missing-plugin repair owner and Codex doctor migration paths.
